text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 502s observed for canary rollout in eu-west1. Metric: canary_502_rate=8.2% (abort threshold=5%). Affected model variant: redwood-v2-quant. Dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/canary?region=eu-west1

maya.sre: Taking this one. Paging devon.eng for rollout context. @devon.eng please confirm what changed in this wave.

devon.eng: Started gradual rollout of 'redwood-v2-quant' to 5% traffic ~8m ago. No infra changes, only model artifact and quant kernels. I can pause the rollout/flip flag.

maya.sre: Observability shows backend timeouts + increased tail latency on inference nodes serving quantized variant. Spike is localized to eu-west1 only. Working hypothesis: quant kernel regression under long-context workloads. Will attempt flag gating.

devon.eng: Executing kill-switch now: `./flagctl set canary_v2_enable false --scope=eu-west1`

incident-bot: ACTION: Feature flag 'canary_v2_enable' set to false by devon.eng at 5223456795. Traffic shift initiating.

maya.sre: Traffic re-routed back to stable model. Canary traffic at ~0%. Waiting 2m for metrics to settle.

liam.prod: Heads up — two SLA customers in eu-west1 reported increased errors (ticket #9876). Recommend drafting an outbound note once rollback confirmed.

support-ops: I'll draft the customer message and hold until you confirm impact window. Can we grab sample request ids?

maya.sre: Sample log: `rid=ab12c3 model=redwood-v2-quant error=upstream_502 seq_len=2048 kv_cache_miss=true` — looks consistent with KV cache / quant path failures.

devon.eng: We saw a similar failure in staging with the new quant kernel. Initiating revert to stable artifact `build-20260212-9`. Applying rollback patch now.

maya.sre: Rollback applied; traffic cutover complete. Monitoring: eu-west1 502 rate dropping to 0.6% and latency back to baseline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: Severity=P2. PagerDuty notified for SRE and eng leads.

devon.eng: Confirmed rollback success. Initial root cause suspected: regression in quantized kernel for long sequences causing upstream timeouts/502s.

liam.prod: I'll coordinate postmortem and customer follow-up. Please attach runbooks, logs, and the time window for impact.

support-ops: Customer note sent to impacted SLAs: "We detected intermittent 502s during a canary rollout in eu-west1 between 5223456789 and 5223456920. We reverted to a stable model and are investigating; support ticket #9876 is open for tracking."

devon.eng: Opening rollback PR + tests to reproduce the quant kernel path with long context. Assigning follow-up to zach.sre. @zach.sre can you own deeper repro and traces?

zach.sre: Picking up. Adding KV cache traces, kernel logs, and scheduling a replay of traffic. Will put findings on the incident board.

maya.sre: Handoff: I'll be available for 30m for any followups, then zach.sre will take over the incident. Tags: #canary-failure #kill-switch #eu-west1. Closing thread after 15m of stable metrics with no regression.

(devon.eng) :thumbsup:
